record.title: Validate bandwidth reader with host policy hashing
record.intent: Remove the unavailable guest utility dependency while retaining the exact bounded reader.
requirements: Preserve failed run01 and exact compiled bandwidth reader. Capture policy bytes before and after with exec-out cat and compare hashes on host; do not install tools or change policy.
Run a new disposable loopback-only guest with distinct four-byte field values. Require three negative controls before memory access and one positive four-read sixteen-byte observation.
Independently audit raw samples, process/file/maps, fixed address geometry, byte budget, policy bytes and system-server health. Seal result and commit/push before selecting continuation.
No physical contact is permitted by this task.
acceptance: The exact reader is validated or a precise independent failure is retained.
